record.field: Training: registration recorded, session to be confirmed
Sent when a website registration is recorded for a session that is not confirmed yet.

div.p: Your registration of participant(s) in the training is recorded, for the session of ( time).
This session is not confirmed yet: please do not pay for now. As soon as it is confirmed, we will send you a payment request to confirm your participation.
Your place is held until ( time).
If you have any questions, you can reply to this message.

record.field: Session confirmed — confirm your participation in {{ object.training_registration_delivery_id.program_id.course_id.name }}
Asks the buyer to pay once the session is confirmed; the place is released after the deadline.

div.p: The session of ( time) of the training is confirmed.
To confirm your participation ( participant(s)), pay for your registration before ( time): after this date, the place is released.
